_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Static Strength Methodology Report
summary: Describes the technical approach and methodologies used to perform the static strength analysis of an aircraft store's structure.
use_relationship:
This report describes the details of the technical approach and methodologies that will be used to perform the static strength analysis of the aircraft store's structure.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content for the data products resulting from work tasks described by the contract statement of work.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Static Strength Methodology Report shall:

children.title: Static analyses methodology
children.content: Describe the methodology used to perform static analyses of the store structure, including joints, fasteners, splices, and fittings.

children.title: Internal load distributions methodology
children.content: Describe the methodology to be used to determine internal load distributions, including for fastened joints and bonded structure.

children.title: Structural stiffness and load transfer methodology
children.content: Describe the methodology to be used to determine structural stiffness, load transfer, panel effectivity and bond line integrity.

children.title: Material allowables methodology
children.content: Describe the methodology to be used to determine or develop material allowables, environmental and other knockdown factors, and corrections where deviations from the constraints under which published allowables are desired.

children.title: Static strength and stability analyses methodology
children.content: Describe the methodology to be used to perform static strength and stability analyses and how margins will be calculated and presented

children.title: Structural design criteria
children.content: Describe the basic structural design criteria that will be employed; factors such as fitting, bearing and others that will be employed.

children.title: Deviations from standard design practices
children.content: Describe any planned deviations from standard aerospace industry accepted structural design practices specified in the contract.
